title: Needle-Point Handbook for the Untrained
summary: A handbook of grip, thrust and withdrawal for the narrow blade, written for students who cannot yet use qi.

title: A Plain Drill-Book of the Narrow Blade
summary: A drill-book of short repeated exercises in stance, poking and parrying for first-year students with plain bodies.

title: Workbook of the Single Stab
summary: A workbook that teaches one clean stab at a time, counting the footwork and hip drive behind each.

title: Treatise on the Slim Point and the Wrist
summary: A short treatise on wrist work with the slim blade, covering feints, pricks and the forearm's small guards.

title: Rules of the Stiletto Grip
summary: A rule-book of forward and reverse grips for the stiletto, with the close-quarters stabs each grip allows.

title: Primer of the Needle Thrust with Breath
summary: A primer that joins each needle thrust to the breath and a first thread of circulating qi.

title: A Canon of Narrow-Blade Footwork
summary: A canon of steps for the stiletto-bearer, teaching narrow lanes, crescent entries and qi-pushed lunges.

title: The Seam-Finder's Drill Sheets
summary: Drill sheets for probing armour joins and cloth seams with the point and pressing in with a little qi.

title: Short Notes on the Awl Hand
summary: Short notes on holding the stiletto hidden in the closed fist and striking from the sleeve.

title: Handbook of Qi-Lit Pinpoint Work
summary: A handbook for gathering qi into one bead at the point and landing repeated thrusts on a single dot.
